review:
The Divine Queen heads to a futuristic Egyptian desert, and she reacts to what happens on the reels. It's a pay-anywhere game with cell multipliers that can grow to 128x.

Booster modes give you more ways to play, and Super Free Spins start with a 2x multiplier in every cell. There's even a one-click button to repeat your last purchase. Clearly built with streamers in mind. Medium-high volatility, 5,000x max and 97% RTP. Free spins roughly once every 234 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
